title: Ada and the Letters
author: Wendell Delacroix
blurb: Casper Vasquez, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
